title: A simple touch can bring dying corals back to life in just 7 weeks
caption:
A new study shows that bleached corals can make a full recovery in just seven weeks by physically connecting to a healthy clone. This discovery highlights the potential for new restoration techniques to help reefs survive heat waves.

Source: Sciencedaily - A simple touch can bring dying corals back to life in just 7 weeks

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261017230025.htm
